readme.text:
# Suikapelago

![](./screenshot.png)

Suikapelago is an Archipelago-compatible clone of Suika Game.

**[Play the game](https://starwort.github.io/suikapelago/)**

notes.text:
Feature: UT support (including Yamlless)
Fix: off-by-one in Scoresanity requirements, most notably making scores logical when using a starting max fruit size of 1 and therefore not actually being possible

Client improvements: Improved the appearance of Blindness Trap (now shows the text 'You are blind!'). Fixed scoresanity requirements not correctly counting towards goal
